description: Flux evidence is a scoped single-file refinement harness that mirrors pure public production surfaces; it does not import or verify the full vb_storage implementation bodies.
justification: Full crate mode has no Flux annotations on these production functions and the recovery crate contains broad concrete Rust/collection/I/O shapes not suitable for first-pass Flux adoption. Single-file mode keeps claims in the decidable fragment.

description: Harness definitions correspond by inspection to the named production proof surfaces in crates/vb_storage/src/recovery/*.rs; Flux does not mechanically link the harness to those functions.
justification: Flux single-file mode is used because crate-mode annotation of the production module was not requested beyond non-behavioral metadata and would require staged adoption across external types.

description: ActionReplayTracker proof abstracts production HashSet membership for one action/step pair into completed/failed booleans and proves the public resolution surface over those booleans.
justification: Flux evidence covers monotonic support-surface logic, not std::collections::HashSet insertion/contains correctness.

description: Trusted-boundary scan over the Flux harness plus mapped production pure-surface files found only #![forbid(unsafe_code)] lines and no Flux trusted/extern_spec/ignore/no_panic markers.
justification: The harness uses checked bodies and #[should_fail] negative obligations, not trusted or ignored code.
